paper_title: Exotic energy injection in the early universe II: CMB spectral distortions and constraints on light dark matter
notes: Headline ALP-photon curve = black 'CMB anisotropy (our work)' contour of Fig. 10, extracted from the vector figure ep/figs/ALP_constraint.pdf (drawing idx 4, black stroke, fill None). This is the paper's own recast of its extended CMB-anisotropy constraint on DM decaying to two photons (a->gamma gamma, m_a=m_chi) into g_agamma, based on Planck 2015 likelihoods (Ref. Slatyer & Wu / DarkHistory), valid from m_a~2R=27.2 eV up to ~1 MeV. Axis calibration from vector minor-tick log spacing: x = 2 + (px-147.8)/78.0 (log10 m/eV), y-fit slope -42.27 px/decade. Paper already plots the canonical g_agamma [GeV^-1] with L=-(g/4)aF Fdual, so no conversion applied. The comparison curves in Fig. 10 (optical depth, EBL, LeoT, X-ray, Bolliet et al.) are from other works (plotted via AxionLimits code) and were NOT used. Two curve points beyond the 10^6 eV frame edge dropped. This is a cosmological (CMB) constraint on the total DM abundance, not a local-density haloscope search, so dm_density_assumed is null. CL taken as 95% following the underlying Planck DM-decay constraint.
